attchmntText: CSM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication with respect to unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: CSM Technologies Limited submitted a newspaper advertisement dated 14th November 2026 regarding its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results were approved by the Board of Directors on 13th November 2026. Laser Power & Infra Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited approved and adopted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 13th November 2026. Wakefit Innovations Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. Monedo Financial Services Private Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report under Regulation 32 of the SEBI for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.

CSM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled " CSM Technologies Reports H1 FY27 Total Income of ₹86.28 Crore; Q2 Total Income at ₹43.04 Crore , ".
CSM Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
